scenarios.name: S1-shim-first-path
scenarios.fixture: A (make_fixture_a 89-109); PATH=shim_dir:clean_path; write_shim 200-204 logs to trip1 then execs /usr/bin/grep
scenarios.assertion: PATH shim never fires and verify-claims matches reference A

scenarios.name: S2-bash-env-function
scenarios.assertion: imported grep() never receives a call and output matches reference A

scenarios.name: S3-no-grep-on-path
scenarios.fixture: A; PATH=nogrep symlink farm of listed tools, grep omitted (465-477)
scenarios.assertion: absolute pin needs no PATH lookup
scenarios.pass: same_as_a(rc, out) and 'not found' not in err

scenarios.name: S6-override-non-gnu
scenarios.fixture: A; RESEARCH_GATE_GREP=stub (write_stub_non_gnu 207-212, version on stderr, exit 0)
scenarios.assertion: non-GNU stub refused after exactly one --version probe
scenarios.pass: rc == 2 and 'GREP_PROVENANCE' in err and stub_version_only (501: one log line whose argv tail is ['--version'])

scenarios.name: S7-override-distinct-path
scenarios.assertion: distinct-path override honoured: output equal, echo fullmatch, recorder received matcher calls
scenarios.pass: same_as_a(rc, out) and echo == want and len(rec_matches) >= 1

scenarios.name: S8-default-echo
scenarios.fixture: A; no override; CHOUSA_GREP_PIN_ECHO=1; default_grep=/usr/bin/grep else /bin/grep
scenarios.assertion: default pin echo names path, source=default, and a live --version

scenarios.name: S9-override-beats-shim
scenarios.fixture: A; BASH_ENV + RESEARCH_GATE_GREP=recorder A + CHOUSA_GREP_PIN_ECHO=1; rlog_a truncated (534) and not read
scenarios.assertion: docstring 29-31: function shim receives nothing AND the recorder receives the matches
scenarios.pass: trip_empty(trip2) and same_as_a(rc, out) and echo == want9

scenarios.name: S10-semantic-canary
scenarios.fixture: B (make_fixture_b 112-136, seeded length 32765..32767 + short span); landed recorder B; patched k1 gate (365-377, 560-566)
scenarios.assertion: every record's span or 4096-byte chunk is a matcher argv on the landed recorder; output-equivalent exact-search attributes no long record
scenarios.pass: ref_b and len(landed_attr)==len(spans_b) and k1_long_missing and k1_same and syntax.returncode==0

scenarios.name: S11-manifest-hash-shim
scenarios.fixture: D (189-197); PATH=hostile sha256sum (590-591) then clean_path; verify-all --json
scenarios.assertion: both manifest sha fields are 64-hex and equal hashlib of the record and the gate

scenarios.name: S12-locale-c
scenarios.fixture: C (139-147): file bytes caf\xc3\xa9; claim span U+00E9, json.dumps ensure_ascii so \\u00e9
scenarios.assertion: docstring 40-41: the claim decodes byte-exactly under LC_ALL=C
scenarios.pass: ref_c (utf-8 rc==0, no drift, L1 supported/match) and rc_c==rc_utf and parse(out_c)==parse(out_utf)

scenarios.name: S13-pin-echo-isolation
scenarios.fixture: cwd=fixture D dir; --pin with CHOUSA_GREP_PIN_ECHO=1; --drift via raw subprocess (633), not run_gate
scenarios.assertion: baseline does not embed GATE_GREP and drift against the unchanged gate is none
scenarios.pass: rc_pin==0 and dr.returncode==0 and dr.stdout.strip()=='GATE_DRIFT: none' and not baseline_has_echo

scenarios.name: S14-pin-drift-token
scenarios.fixture: cwd=fixture D dir; --pin; inject one GATE_GREP line after the canonical-output marker (647-651); --drift
scenarios.assertion: injected GATE_GREP line pairs as -GATE_GREP, not -LINE
scenarios.pass: rc_pin2==0 and dr2.returncode==1 and '-GATE_GREP' in dr2.stdout and '-LINE' not in dr2.stdout
